com.ibm.cos.v2.http

Class SdkAsyncHttpClientH1TestSuite

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.http.SdkAsyncHttpClientH1TestSuite

  • public abstract class SdkAsyncHttpClientH1TestSuite
extends Object
    A set of tests validating that the functionality implemented by a SdkAsyncHttpClient for HTTP/1 requests This is used by an HTTP plugin implementation by extending this class and implementing the abstract methods to provide this suite with a testable HTTP client implementation.
